name: animation-archive
description: Static site generator for Global Animation Archive - pulls from Notion, builds HTML

scripts.fetch:all: npm run fetch && npm run fetch:links
scripts.dev: npm run fetch:all && npm run build && npx serve dist
scripts.deploy: npm run fetch:all && npm run build
scripts.data-check: npm run audit && npm run validate
scripts.ci: npm run audit && npm run build && npm run audit:a11y
